_meta.description: Decision log for this repository. D-01..D-20 are recorded for Prod2 on 2026-11-19 by session arena/cd3cddd6-prod2; carried intents from the predecessor register are named where they exist. Statuses: Recorded, Partly recorded (a named part is still open), Carried (predecessor decision re-stated without change).

decisions.title: Adopt the publication brand 'The Crisp Counter'
decisions.rationale: The predecessor site published under its project codename (Zone4, its D-18 kept the codename pending clearance). This site is a reader-facing publication and needs a name a reader can remember; 'The Crisp Counter' names the kitchen surface every air fryer competes for. Clearance is open question Q-10.

decisions.title: Adopt the warm-editorial design direction with non-photographic brand graphics
decisions.rationale: Carries the predecessor's DIR-A warm-editorial direction (its D-35): serif display over a warm paper palette, story-led hero, rule-topped cards. Graphics are drawn, not photographed, until the photography question is decided (Q-05, FLG-10).

decisions.title: Unique title and meta description on every page
decisions.rationale: Per Google's snippet guidance; enforced by check.py (unique, non-trivial lengths). Carries predecessor S-04.

decisions.title: Every outbound Amazon link carries rel="sponsored"; disclosure adjacent
decisions.rationale: Google's outbound-link qualification plus the FTC placement guidance. The generator adds the rel automatically; the check fails the build if an Amazon link is unmarked or the disclosure strip is missing. Carries predecessor S-05.

decisions.title: Front page is a storefront: shop, guides and comparison first; dashboards in the footer directory
decisions.rationale: The reader-facing goal: lead with products, keep every dashboard surface reachable from the footer and a single navigation group. Carries predecessor D-38/S-17.

decisions.title: Eight question-shaped guides ship at launch; cadence of one new guide per 14 days
decisions.rationale: The four brief hypotheses plus four spec-backed topics in the same shape. Each new guide joins sitemap.xml and feed.xml in the same build. Carries predecessor S-07/S-13 and its publishing cadence.

decisions.title: Voice standard adopted before any copy was written
decisions.rationale: Every guide and page is written to VOICE.md; the anti-slop lint enforces the banned patterns on reader-facing pages. Carries predecessor S-12.

decisions.title: Evidence rule for 'trending' and popularity claims
decisions.rationale: No page states that a product or topic is trending, best-selling or most popular without a dated official source; none exists, so no such claim appears. The lint bans the words on reader-facing pages. Carries predecessor S-16/F-15.

decisions.title: Five defined events; privacy-preserving counter; self-hosted collector as reference code
decisions.rationale: The five events mirror the attribution model in the carried ledger (impression, click, session, order, refund as reported events) and the client records the two it can observe honestly (page_view, product_link_click, plus engagement events in its own namespace). Hosting the collector is open (Q-06, FLG-08).

decisions.title: Campaign ledger stays empty until an authorised first-party report exists
decisions.rationale: Rows are added only from an authorised Associates Central report with a report reference. No conversion score, no revenue forecast, anywhere. Carries the predecessor ledger and its OA Section 4 note.

decisions.title: Product-intent record keeps intended and observed fields separate
decisions.rationale: For each submitted link: intended ASIN, official listing URL, confirmation date and source; observed redirect targets in their own field with their own date. The fields are never merged. Check-enforced.

decisions.title: Three-question chooser above the comparison table
decisions.rationale: Chooser asks about counter space, typical cooking and cleanup preference, then names which spec priorities matter - it recommends formats, never products, so it stays honest while attribution is unverified. Carries predecessor S-19.

decisions.title: No generated or copied product photography; drawn brand graphics only
decisions.rationale: Carries predecessor S-18's rule: real product photography needs a sourcing decision (original, licensed stock, or API-served imagery) which is open as Q-05. Until then the site ships no photography at all.

decisions.title: Counter-space analysis published as a method with verified-only product rows
decisions.rationale: Capacity per centimetre of counter depth for the verified three, with the arithmetic shown so a reader can run it on any shortlist. Carries predecessor S-23.

decisions.title: Mobile-first presentation: fluid type, 44px tap targets, sticky compare bar
decisions.rationale: Per Google's page-experience guidance. Carries predecessor S-20.

decisions.title: Internal linking: every guide reaches the comparison, a category page and at least two sibling guides
decisions.rationale: Check-enforced. Carries predecessor S-24.

decisions.title: Flag page split open / resolved / historical; checks run from a clean checkout
decisions.rationale: Carries predecessor S-10/S-11: docs must match code (ENGINE.md's check count is asserted by check.py) and CI runs build + checks on every push.

decisions.title: Docs and code reconciled: one build, one check suite, no hand-maintained counts
decisions.rationale: ENGINE.md documents the pipeline the two scripts actually implement; the check count line is verified against the code on every run.

decisions.title: Suggestions and open questions are published pages, not private notes
decisions.rationale: The brief asks for a dedicated suggestions section someone can review before changes are made, and a clear list of questions, information and answers needed before decisions. Both registers are rendered from data, so a review can happen without touching the build.

decisions.title: P4/P5 stay unpublished while held
decisions.rationale: Carried from the predecessor register (F-55/F-56 there): identity never confirmed by the owner; listings observed outside the air-fryer scope. They appear in the registers, never on shop pages.

decisions.title: Amazon IP notice (Section 2(k)) shown in the footer of every page
decisions.rationale: Carried conservative reading from the predecessor register: listing titles are Program Content displayed as text, so the notice is shown in plain view on every page.
